messages:
jana (eng): creating RC from main: rwinf-rc-2026-03-21-7 (sha:deadbeef). Found a small regression in prefix batching; pushing a hotfix patch on top (sha:deadbeef+hf1). Requesting pin for promo window planned 2026-03-22 01:00-03:00 UTC.

rohit (release): Noted. Please include a short release note blurb and confirm whether this needs an extended canary.

petra (qa): Running quick regression on routing and batching. Will smoke in staging now.

deploybot: CI: ❌ 1 failing integration (tests/integration/prefix_batching_test). Image not promoted. See: https://ci.redwood/runs/4421

jana (eng): failing test reproduces locally; root cause is an edge case where short-prefixes + caching reorder tokens. Pushing fix and re-run.

deploybot: CI: ✅ all checks passed, image pushed (gcr/redwood/rwinf:rc-2026-03-21-7-hf1).

petra (qa): Re-ran smoke: 2/3 flakes earlier, now PASS. Observed p95 gen latency 340ms in staging. One note: first-request cold hit latency slightly higher, KV warm advised.

kai (sre): KV warm recommended. I can schedule warm 20m before canary. Also suggest delaying promo window by +1h to give ops time to verify canary dashboards. Any objections?

rohit (release): Delay OK with product. Moving window to 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC. Jana, confirm no user-visible schema changes.

jana (eng): Confirmed: no schema changes. Hotfix limited to batching heuristics and cache ordering.

release-council-bot: Release note draft: "Fix: prefix batching reorder bug causing intermittent quality regressions; improved cold-request handling. No breaking changes." Please approve.

petra (qa): +1 approval. Staging pass looks stable. Test artifact: rwinf-rc-2026-03-21-7-hf1

kai (sre): KV warm job scheduled: `/ops/run_kv_warm --artifact rwinf-rc-2026-03-21-7-hf1 --duration=20m --workers=6 --region=us-east1`. Will watch cache hitrate and p95. Abort criteria: sustained error rate >1.5% for 4m OR p95 > 600ms for 3m. Rollback command prepared: `deploybot rollback --to rwinf-stable-2026-03-18-7 --reason=regress-hotfix`

rohit (release): Pinning artifact rwinf-rc-2026-03-21-7-hf1. Noting delayed window. Need one more +1 from infra and QA to proceed.

petra (qa): +1.

kai (sre): +1. Monitoring hooks created, will post canary metrics on start.

jana (eng): Thanks team. Updating release-log and release notes. I'll be standing by during the window.
